title: Undo, Safely
prompt:
You committed too early. Fill the object:
- `redo`: the command that creates a NEW commit reversing your last one (never rewrite shared history).
- `inspect`: the command that shows the commit history.

tests.name: inspect the history
revert, not reset
tests.hint: git revert HEAD is safe for shared branches — it adds an inverse commit.

tests.name: no history rewriting
tests.hint: Revert adds history; reset/force-push destroys it. On shared branches: revert.
